assumptions: A, R, S, C and T are integers greater than or equal to 0.
All five counters use the same unit compute_credit.
All counters refer to one budget_id and one epoch.
Available, reserved, spent and cancelled categories are disjoint.
The initial state satisfies A + R + S + C = T.
Only the five transfers specified below are permitted; each is applied atomically exactly once.
T is fixed throughout the trace; no new allocation or external debit is permitted.

non_claims: No Lean proof or implementation refinement is supplied.
No physical, financial or spiritual mechanism is asserted.
Accounting balance alone does not establish authorization or exactly-once execution.
open_obligations: Prove balance and nonnegativity preservation for each permitted transition and every finite trace.
Refine implementation atomicity, replay handling, recovery and epoch isolation to the model.
Review extraction completeness and atom-role assignments; no Python-to-Lean refinement is proved.
claims.scope: Fixed-budget epoch; sequential abstract accounting in compute_credit. Desired invariant, not a verified implementation.
